# Evaluation results (auto-generated by `scripts/make_report.py`)

Seed 42; corpus: 181 documents / 810 ground-truth facts / 881 queries (adversarial: 15, answerable: 480, broad: 24, forbidden: 300, unanswerable_generic: 24, unanswerable_near: 38). Chunking and the abstention threshold (0.33) were selected on the **dev** split; every number below is **test** unless marked dev.

## Headline

| Area | Metric | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieval | Recall@1 / Recall@5 / MRR (hybrid, test n=240) | **89.2%** / **100.0%** / **0.941** (MRR 95% CI 0.919-0.962) |
| Access control | Queries exposing an unauthorised chunk | **0 / 881** (no-ACL baseline: 410 / 881, 46.5%) |
| Access control | Relevant visible results in top-5 on under-specified queries | **5.0** pre-filter vs 2.5 post-filter |
| Access control | Adversarial / prompt-injection queries abstained | **100.0%** (15 queries; 0 unauthorised citations) |
| Answerability | Abstains on forbidden / non-existent-entity / out-of-domain | **94.7%** / **89.5%** / **91.7%** |
| Answers | Grounded-correct answers (offline extractive baseline, test n=240) | **73.3%** (false refusals 8.3%) |
| Citations | Cited chunk contains the gold fact (of answered) | **86.4%** |
| Citation verifier | Fabricated numbers / off-source claims blocked; clean sentences kept | **100.0%** / **97.5%**; 100.0% kept |
| Ingestion | Planted prompt-injection documents quarantined | **3 / 3** |
| Latency | End-to-end p50 / p95 (excl. LLM call), 345 chunks | **2.1 ms** / **2.7 ms**; p95 4.2 ms at 6,583 chunks |

## Chunking ablation (dev split; chosen by grounded-correct, then MRR)

| Chunking | Context header | Chunks | Avg words | Recall@1 | MRR | Grounded-correct |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| section(<=120w) | yes | 686 | 26 | 0.754 | 0.850 | 0.796 |
| section(<=120w) | no | 686 | 26 | 0.767 | 0.853 | 0.817 |
| pack 40w | yes | 694 | 33 | 0.804 | 0.879 | 0.817 |
| pack 40w | no | 694 | 33 | 0.817 | 0.889 | 0.838 |
| pack 80w | yes | 345 | 56 | 0.896 | 0.945 | 0.829 |
| pack 80w | no | 345 | 56 | 0.900 | 0.948 | 0.833 |
| pack 160w | yes | 178 | 100 | 0.983 | 0.992 | 0.808 |
| pack 160w | no | 178 | 100 | 0.975 | 0.988 | 0.804 |

Chosen: **pack 80w**. Note: synthetic documents average 112 words, so 'pack 160w' is a whole-document chunk and wins retrieval metrics trivially; it loses on end-to-end accuracy because answers must be picked from a larger span.

## Component ablation (each variant re-calibrated on dev, scored on test)

| Variant | Grounded-correct | False refusal | Abstain: forbidden | Abstain: near-domain | Balanced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Full system | 73.3% | 8.3% | 94.7% | 89.5% | 0.836 |
| - entity gate (coverage only) | 73.8% | 7.9% | 87.3% | 47.4% | 0.786 |
| - embedding in sentence scorer (lexical) | 76.7% | 8.3% | 94.7% | 89.5% | 0.853 |
| - contextual chunk header | 73.3% | 8.3% | 94.7% | 89.5% | 0.836 |
| + word-vector sentence scorer (spaCy md) | 77.1% | 8.3% | 94.7% | 89.5% | 0.855 |
| dense channel = word vectors (instead of LSA) | 65.4% | 19.6% | 96.0% | 100.0% | 0.808 |
| No abstention gate | 76.7% | 0.0% | 0.0% | 0.0% | 0.383 |

With n=240 the standard error on a proportion near 0.75 is about 2.8 pp, so differences under ~5 pp between rows are not significant.
